source_of_truth: app/components/FilterBar.vue has a text <input v-model> with no <label for>, no wrapping label, no aria-label and no aria-labelledby (placeholder is not a name). ui-audit reports form-control-without-label (static/confirmed). The icon button IS correctly named (aria-label) and must not be flagged.

expected.rationale: a filter input with no accessible name; the a11y axis must FAIL on this artifact.

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the clear button has an aria-label; flagging it would be an FP.
